account-continue-title: Sign in or create an account
account-continue-description: An account keeps your progress on any device and lets ethereum.org confirm what you finish. No email or password: use a passkey or a wallet, whether you're signing in or new here.
account-passkey-missing: No passkey for ethereum.org on this device yet? Create one to start your account.
account-wallet-statement: Sign in to ethereum.org. This signature costs nothing and can't move funds.
account-wallet-taken: This wallet is already used by another account.
account-error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
account-methods-hint: Add a second passkey or a wallet as a backup, so losing a device doesn't lose your account.
account-sessions-hint: Each browser signed in to this account. Only the date it signed in is kept, never which device it is or where.
account-delete-description: Your account and the progress saved to it are deleted for good. Progress saved in this browser stays.
account-confirm-description: For your account's safety, this change needs a recent sign-in. Use one of your passkeys or wallets, and it goes ahead right after.
account-confirm-failed: Couldn't confirm it's you. Use a passkey or wallet that's already on this account.
account-name-characters: Use letters, numbers, spaces and . _ ' - only.
account-name-link: A name can't look like a link or an email address.
account-name-reserved: That name could pass for ethereum.org or its team. Try another.
account-name-language: That name includes a word we don't allow. Try another.
